result.reason: The operative language fully satisfies the preferred insurance position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all coverages to continue for one year after the Agreement's term and expressly places the expense on HDI, neither of which was required by the stated positions. The amendment leaves the headings and counterparts provision intact and introduces no evident contradiction, but the added post-termination duration is a substantive obligation beyond the requested insurance requirements.
